crossRefs.note: wild animals and all livestock; small creatures and flying birds;
God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the…
“Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
“Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?
“See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
“Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

translations.web: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
translations.bsb: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
translations.kjv: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
translations.asv: The birds of the heavens, and the fish of the sea, Whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
